name: Belittling
overview: Scripture reveals that belittling others often stems from hypocrisy and a failure to care for the weak, as seen when leaders rule with cruelty instead of healing the broken (Ezekiel 34:4) and when they say one thing but do another (Matthew 23:3). Such actions not only harm others but also lead people away from God’s truth, making them spiritually worse off (Matthew 23:15). In contrast, God’s ways and thoughts transcend human understanding (Isaiah 55:8), and His love is demonstrated through the giving of His Son to bring eternal life to believers (John 3:16), calling us to reflect His grace rather than diminish others.
